name: chat-sidecar
description: A side pane for the current chat that shows what Claude is doing, what's waiting on you, and what it's using: the to-do list, tasks Claude gives you, answered in place, subagents, background processes, connectors, context files and skills of this chat, in one side pane; the plan band above the prompt

showTodo.title: Show To-do
showTodo.description: Draw the To-do section. Off, it is not drawn and its background work stops.

showTasks.title: Show Tasks for me
showTasks.description: Draw the Tasks for me section. Off, it is not drawn and its background work stops.

showSubagents.title: Show Subagents
showSubagents.description: Draw the Subagents section. Off, it is not drawn and its background work stops.

showBackground.title: Show Background
showBackground.description: Draw the Background section. Off, it is not drawn and its background work stops.

showConnectors.title: Show Connectors
showConnectors.description: Draw the Connectors section. Off, it is not drawn and its background work stops.

showFiles.title: Show Context files
showFiles.description: Draw the Context files section. Off, it is not drawn and its background work stops.

showSkills.title: Show Skills
showSkills.description: Draw the Skills section. Off, it is not drawn and its background work stops.

showGit.title: Show Git
showGit.description: Draw the Git section (the base branch, whether this is a worktree, the main repo). Off, it is not drawn and git is not run.

sectionOrder.title: Section order
sectionOrder.description: The order the sections are drawn in, ids separated by commas: todo, tasks, subagents, background, connectors, files, skills, git. Unknown ids are skipped and missing ones go last.
sectionOrder.default: todo, tasks, subagents, background, connectors, files, skills, git

bandColor.title: Plan band colour
bandColor.description: The colour of the plan band above the prompt: purple, green (bottle green), burgundy, navy or orange.

barStyle.title: Bar style
barStyle.description: The terminal's bar style for the plan band and the subagent cards: gradient, segments, line, dots (one per step) or pixel (braille).

ports.title: Watched ports
ports.description: Ports to show when something listens on them, as port=label separated by commas, e.g. 8090=backend, 4200=frontend. The label debug draws the entry in the debug color.

pollSeconds.title: Port check interval (s)
pollSeconds.description: How often the watched ports are checked (netstat on Windows, ss on Linux). At least 2.

jobsSeconds.title: Test process scan interval (s)
jobsSeconds.description: How often running tests are looked for. The scan costs about 1 s of CPU on Windows (PowerShell). At least the port interval.

testWarnMinutes.title: Tests: yellow after (min)
testWarnMinutes.description: A test run going this long turns yellow.

testErrorMinutes.title: Tests: red after (min)
testErrorMinutes.description: A test run going this long turns red: probably hung.

serverWarnHours.title: Servers: yellow after (h)
serverWarnHours.description: A server listening this long turns yellow: probably forgotten.
